title: Pokkiri Raja
desc: Raja takes the blame for a murder committed by his father and is deserted by him. Years later, his father comes seeking his help when his younger brother, Surya, is falsely imprisoned.

title: Biriyani
desc: Sugan and Parasuram leave Varadharajan's party drunk in search of a place to have biryani. Soon, they get into some serious trouble when they find a corpse in the trunk of their car.

title: Vanangaan
desc: A vigilante with a hearing impairment faces punishment for his various crimes against the injustices of society.

title: Mutant Tiger
desc: In order to gain eternal youth, a eunuch dabbles in tiger essence. Trouble ensues when his experiment goes awry, causing mutated tigers to attack the city.

title: Pokkiri
desc: Thamizh, an undercover officer posing as a hitman, falls for Shruthi, who disapproves of his violent lifestyle. Their growing bond faces risks from his hidden mission.

title: 365 Repeat the Year
desc: A detective and a webtoon artist gets a chance to reset their lives by a year, but their new reality takes an unexpected turn with mysterious and dangerous consequences.

title: Saamy
desc: Aarusaamy, a police officer, accepts bribes from Perumal, a gangster, in order to maintain peace in his district. However, circumstances force him to go against Perumal.
